description.value:
Your enemy's heart has been stopped, but you cause it to start pumping blood once again. The unfamiliar sensation is enough to throw the creature off-kilter, while the blood itself damages the flesh of the undead. The target attempts a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[1d6[persistent,acid]] damage.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute and takes @Damage[2d6[persistent,acid]] damage.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 2} for 1 minute and takes @Damage[3d6[persistent,acid]] damage.
